name: static_bloom
theme: a retro living room where the television is the portal — in through the phosphor grid to the static's magnetic domains, out through the broadcast picture onto a golden savanna, and home to the same room

registers.name: living_room
registers.scene: a cozy 1970s living room at night seen from across the room at seated eye level, empty, no one present, patterned wallpaper and a deep shag carpet, a low couch and a side table under a warm amber lamp, a wood-cabinet television in the far corner, its curved glass face pale with silver static grain
registers.target: a wood-cabinet television, its curved glass face full of pale silver static grain, a heavy dark wooden frame around the glass and a row of round dials beneath it
registers.loop_target: the cozy lamplit 1970s living room seen from across the room, patterned wallpaper, a low couch and a shag carpet, a wood-cabinet television glowing pale silver in the far corner

registers.name: screen
registers.scene: the curved glass face of a television in its wood cabinet, a dense mottled field of silver and charcoal grain across the whole pane, the dark wooden frame and a row of round dials at its edge, dim patterned wallpaper beyond
registers.target: a cluster of small round points of red, green and blue light

registers.name: phosphor
registers.palette: scarlet, green and blue points on jet black
registers.scene: ranks of glowing scarlet, green and blue phosphor dots in strict rows behind a fine black mask, each dot a rounded bead of colored light, the black lattice between them sharp and geometric
registers.target: a bright patch of pale silver light, its border jagged and torn

registers.name: ising_domains
registers.scene: a dense mottled field of magnetic domains, ragged patches of white and charcoal locked into a percolation mosaic, thin pale borders threading between the patches, the whole field flat and crowded to the edges

registers.name: savanna
registers.scene: a vast golden savanna seen from high in the air in low evening light, flat-topped acacia trees scattered across the burnt-gold plain, a winding river threading between pale sandbars, long shadows laid across the grass
registers.target: a lone flat-topped acacia tree, a wide crown of fine leaves over a dark trunk

registers.name: acacia
registers.scene: a lone flat-topped acacia in tall golden grass, its wide crown of fine leaves over a dark twisted trunk, woven grass nests hung in the branches, the low sun a round amber disc behind the crown
registers.target: the setting sun, a large round amber disc, its glow broad and warm

registers.name: den
registers.scene: a 1970s den seen low across a patterned carpet from the dark hallway doorway, empty, no one present, a wood-cabinet television in the corner with its curved glass face a warm field of gold and orange light, an amber lamp on a side table beside it, patterned wallpaper and a low couch in the dim room

music_theme: a warm nostalgic analog nocturne — soft electric piano and tape hum over a slow pulse, a silver shimmer of noise through the descent, opening into broad golden strings when the picture resolves onto the plain
